title: QPredSGG: Hybrid Quantum Predicate Learning for Long-Tailed Scene Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2606.04689v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scene Graph Generation (SGG) requires relational reasoning over objects and their interactions, but performance is constrained by long-tail predicate imbalance. Classical SGG models rely on dataset statistics, leading to biased predictions toward frequent relations rather than fine-grained semantic predicates. Although debiasing improves mean recall, predicate classification in existing frameworks still relies on high-dimensional classical decision modules with high parameter overhead. This work introduces a resource-efficient hybrid quantum predicate classifier for SGG by replacing the classical predicate head in the CFEN with a QP-Head trained using class-balanced WCE. To the best of our knowledge, this work is among the first evaluations of a hybrid quantum architecture for scene graph predicate classification on Visual Genome 150. We evaluate the impact of qubit count, encoding strategy, entangling topology, and circuit dep

translated_title: QPredSGG：面向长尾场景图生成的混合量子谓词学习
translated_abstract: 场景图生成（SGG）需要对对象及其交互进行关系推理，但其性能受限于长尾谓词分布不平衡问题。经典SGG模型依赖数据集统计信息，导致预测偏向高频关系而非细粒度语义谓词。尽管去偏方法能够提升平均召回率，但现有框架中的谓词分类仍依赖参数开销高昂的高维经典决策模块。本工作提出了一种资源高效的SGG混合量子谓词分类器，通过使用基于类别平衡加权交叉熵（WCE）训练的QP-Head替换CFEN中的经典谓词头。据我们所知，本工作是首批在Visual Genome 150上评估混合量子架构用于场景图谓词分类的研究之一。我们评估了量子比特数量、编码策略、纠缠拓扑以及电路深度……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文通过用量子比特数、编码策略等可调的混合量子谓词头（QP-Head）替换经典谓词分类模块，实现了面向长尾分布、资源高效的场景图生成，并成为首批在Visual Genome 150上验证混合量子架构用于谓词分类的工作之一。
